theme.darkModeHint: Switch between light and dark mode (Ctrl+L)
theme.pdfHint: Applies the theme colors to PDF page content
theme.hideScrollbarsHint: Scrollbars are hidden and appear only while scrolling (Ctrl+Shift+H)
theme.zoomHint: Changes the size of the whole app interface

app.uiLanguageHint: Changing the language reloads the app
app.newTabHint: The page opened by a new tab
app.recent: Show recently opened documents on the home page
app.recentHint: Shows shortcut tiles for recently opened files at the bottom of the home page
app.frequent: Show frequent folders on the home page
app.frequentHint: Folders files are opened from most; click to pick a file in the folder
app.titleBarButtonsHint: Click a button to toggle whether it is shown

font.headerHint: Font for chapter and section headings
font.textHint: Font for the book body text
font.taamimHint: Font for body text in books marked with biblical cantillation
font.sizeHint: Text size relative to the default
font.weightHint: Text weight. Books with cantillation have only two levels: regular and bold
font.lineModeHint: 'Exact' keeps identical spacing between all lines, even when a line has a large word. Note: a very large word may overlap the line above

excluded.pickTitle: Choose a folder to exclude from file search
excluded.title: Folders excluded from file search
excluded.desc: These folders are excluded from file search results. Changes take effect immediately.

advanced.serviceHint: Runs the library in the background as a Windows service: faster startup, a file search index of your documents, and the service stays ready between Word and the app. Installation asks for administrator approval once.
advanced.hbFolder: Folder for keeping HebrewBooks books permanently (optional)
advanced.hbFolderHint: By default, downloaded books are kept in a temporary cache of the last 10 books. Choose a folder to keep every downloaded book permanently; it is created if missing. You can choose the book folder of the digital bookshelf app.
advanced.dbPathHint: Changing the path restarts the data service and rebuilds the search index if needed.
advanced.excludedHint: Folders excluded from file search results. Changes take effect immediately; no index rebuild needed.

calendar.cityHint: Calendar prayer times are calculated for this city
calendar.clockHint: A transparent clock in the bottom-left corner while in full screen

censor.mainHint: Choose how the explicit divine name is written. The full-spelling option turns off covering for all divine names
censor.elokimHint: Also applies to related forms. When a letter is replaced, vowels and cantillation stay in place
censor.other: Cover other divine names with a hyphen
censor.otherHint: Names with no letter to replace, so they can only be split with a hyphen. Click a name to toggle covering

updates.unavailable: Update status is unavailable right now: the data service is not available.
updates.checking: Checking for a new version. If there is one, it downloads now; this may take a few minutes.
updates.failed: Could not check for updates. Please try again later.
updates.upToDate: The installed version is the latest.
updates.idle: No update is ready to install. The app checks for new versions periodically and downloads them in the background.
updates.waitInstaller: Please wait a moment for the installer to open
updates.disableHint: When set to Yes the app will not check for or download new versions. Shared with the Word add-in.

tint.hint: How strong the theme background color is (beige, green, etc.). Brightness does not change, so reading stays comfortable.

book.rememberHint: When reopening a book, the app returns to where you stopped reading
book.maxWidthHint: Shorter lines are easier to read

commentary.sync: Sync commentaries by default when opening a book
commentary.syncHint: Can be changed per book with the sync commentaries toolbar button

reset.settingsConfirm: This resets display and reading settings to defaults. The database and reading history are not affected.
reset.searchIndexConfirm: This deletes the search index and search results cache and rebuilds the index. Other app data is not affected.
reset.searchIndexDone: The library content search index was reset successfully.
reset.catalogConfirm: This deletes the book title and table of contents search index and rebuilds it from the library. Other app data is not affected.
reset.catalogDone: The catalog search index was reset. Rebuilding now runs in the background.
reset.filesConfirm: This deletes the file search index and rebuilds it from scratch. Rebuilding may take a few minutes.
reset.filesDone: The file search index was reset. Rebuilding now runs in the background.
reset.allConfirm: This deletes all app data and all search indexes and reloads the app. Rebuilding the indexes may take a few minutes. This cannot be undone.
reset.settingsDesc: Resets only display and reading settings to defaults. The database, reading history and open tabs are kept.
reset.searchIndexDesc: Deletes the search index and rebuilds it. Other app data is not affected.
reset.catalogDesc: Deletes the book title and table of contents search index and rebuilds it from the library. Other app data is not affected.
reset.filesDesc: Deletes the file search index and rebuilds it from scratch. Rebuilding may take a few minutes.
reset.allDesc: Deletes all app data: settings, reading history, scroll positions, open tabs, and the library, catalog and file search indexes. This cannot be undone.
